Wine group sells label back to founding family

Senior reporter · Oct 12, 2026 – 12.52pm

A listed wine group has sold one of its best known labels back to the family that founded it, for a fraction of the price it paid two decades ago, as it narrows its range to premium brands.

The sale, announced to the market on Monday, ends a long association between the label and the group.
